comment: Vendoring policy manifest. Derived file relationships are discovered from repo scans plus explicit overrides. Mechanism is declared here, never detected: gen_inventory used to promote unknown to copy_script when the provenance scan found a copy script in an active or generated repo, which withheld the fact for the three copy-script repos categorized stale, and would have asserted it wrongly for codex-index-leningrad, whose script copies from UXLC-utils rather than from here. Removed 2026-08-02; unknown now means only that nobody has said (#60). Category answers 'is this copy being kept up?' and mechanism answers 'by what?' (5fc4a77). Category's four values -- active, generated, stale, unmeasured -- are a closed set, checked by vendoring/repo_policy.py's CATEGORY_VALUES, where each one is glossed; unmeasured replaced the retired deferred on 2026-08-07 (#60). Category is not read off last_synced and cannot be: compare.py derives last_synced from the date of the last commit touching each file in the destination repo, so a file that a re-vendor run leaves byte-identical keeps its old date, and a repo whose copies are all up to date still shows mixed.

holman-ketiv-qere.comment: Active vendored copies. py/main_update_vendored_files.py copies MAM-basics/py/mb_cmn and py/mb_diff_mpu by intersection; declared here like the other three such repos, rather than left for gen_inventory to derive from the provenance scan.

al-hatorah.comment: Active since 2026-08-07: py/main_update_vendored_files.py copies MAM-basics/py/mb_cmn by intersection, al-hatorah c4f0e48a ran it, and all 28 files read identical -- kept up on the same footing as holman-ketiv-qere. It read stale until then, which is also why the mechanism is declared here rather than derived: gen_inventory only derives copy_script for an active or generated repo, so this repo's script went unreported for as long as the category said stale (2026-08-02, #60).

codex-index-leningrad.comment: The main_update_vendored_files.py the provenance scan finds here is not a MAM-basics one: it refreshes UXLC-utils-sparse from the sibling UXLC-utils, and never touches lenin-wiki/py/. So unknown is the true mechanism for the four rows below, and the detected copy script must not be read as covering them (2026-08-02, #60).

diffable-pointed-hebrew.comment: Unmeasured rather than stale, and the only repo in that category: nobody has looked at how far these eight files have drifted. doc/PLAN-evacuate-python-programme.md's Appendix B is the statement -- seven read DIFFERS and one eol-only, no copy script has ever refreshed them, and it calls that a bug of unknown size rather than an abandoned copy, with the fix being to give the repo a main_update_vendored_files.py and get the rows to identical/copy_script. Changed from stale on 2026-08-07 (#60).

mgketer.comment: Active since 2026-08-07 for the two directories py/main_update_vendored_files.py covers: it copies MAM-basics/py/mb_cmn and py/mb_diff_mpu by intersection, mgketer 72be9724 ran it, and all 16 files in those two read identical. It covers only those two directories, so the two py/python_modules/ overrides below re-declare mechanism unknown AND category stale rather than inherit copy_script and active -- no script reaches that directory and both files read DIFFERS, which is what stale says and active would deny.
